lines.en: My armor rattles, hollow inside.

lines.zh: 我拖着腿走，骨头磨着甲。
lines.en: I drag my leg; bone grinds on steel.

lines.zh: 每走一步，甲缝掉下铁锈。
lines.en: Each step, rust sifts from my seams.

lines.zh: 我按着剑，像还记得怎么走。
lines.en: I hold my sword as if I still recall how.
The grass yellows under my steps.

lines.zh: 我的头盔有点歪，遮住眼窝。
lines.en: My helm sits askew over empty sockets.
My shield is long gone; only the hook remains.
I walk slowly, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 风从甲缝穿过去，发出低音。
lines.en: Wind through my seams makes a low note.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，土是凉的。
lines.en: The soil stays cold where I have trodden.
I count the flagstones, one per step.

lines.zh: 旧披风只剩半幅，挂在肩上。
lines.en: Half a cloak still hangs from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我站着，骨头在甲里松了。
lines.en: I stand; bones shift loose in the armor.
I listen to my own plates settling.

lines.zh: 空空的头盔里，只有风在转。
lines.en: Only wind turns inside my empty helm.

lines.zh: 我记得一场没打完的仗。
lines.en: I remember a battle that never ended.

lines.zh: 我把剑插在土里，歇一歇。
lines.en: I plant my sword and rest a while.
Insects have nested inside my armor.
I look up; the moon is too bright.
My fingers still grip the hilt.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的号令。
lines.en: I wait for an order that will not come.

lines.zh: 铁锈的味道，是我自己的。
lines.en: The smell of rust is my own.

lines.zh: 你身上有热，我很久没碰过了。
lines.en: You carry warmth; I have not felt it in years.

lines.zh: 我转过来，脖子响了一声。
lines.en: I turn; my neck clicks once.
Have you come to collect me?

lines.zh: 我记得活人走路的样子。
lines.en: I recall how the living walk.
Your face is hard for me to see.
Do not stand so close; I am cold.
Do you carry keys at your belt?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有武器。
lines.en: I watch your hands for any weapon.
I can hear the sound of your breathing.

lines.zh: 我点了点头，头盔晃了一下。
lines.en: I nod; my helmet lurches slightly.

lines.zh: 甲被砍开一道口，风穿过去。
lines.en: A cut opens my plate; wind passes through.

lines.zh: 我掉了半块肩甲，不碍事。
lines.en: Half a pauldron falls; it does not matter.
Pain is a long way behind me.

lines.zh: 骨头断了一根，我照样站着。
lines.en: A bone snaps; I remain standing.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我想起死的那天。
lines.en: That blow reminds me of the day I died.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，铁屑簌簌落下。
lines.en: I sway, and iron flakes patter down.

lines.zh: 你砍在头盔上，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: You struck my helm; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 我又掉了一块铁，收着吧。
lines.en: Another piece of iron falls; keep it.

lines.zh: 这具身体，比我想的结实。
lines.en: This body is sturdier than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的剑还在手上，那就够了。
lines.en: My sword is still in hand; that is enough.
Iron? Give me a piece of iron.
That key; I know its teeth.
Bones are of no use to me now.

lines.zh: 给我一把剑，我替你举着。
lines.en: Give me a sword; I will raise it for you.
I smell damp graveyard soil.
That kind of light hurts when I near it.

lines.zh: 那副新甲，是给活人穿的。
lines.en: That new armor is made for the living.

lines.zh: 给我一块亮着的铁就好。
lines.en: Just give me a piece of shining iron.

lines.zh: 你的火把，让我想起营地。
lines.en: Your torch reminds me of camp.
No flowers; flowers wilt too fast.
What you knocked apart was an empty shell.
Half my pauldron falls off.
You knocked the dust off me.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，骨头咔了一声。
lines.en: I step back; a bone cracks.
Do not push; my clasps would open.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞得我晃了一下。
lines.en: Your shoulder made me sway.
I am lighter than I look.

lines.zh: 那面盾我要是有就好了。
lines.en: If only I still had that shield.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我掉下的铁片。
lines.en: You stepped on a shard I dropped.
I shed rust at a touch; pay it no mind.
The dead have no such business.

lines.zh: 我的队伍留在上一场仗里。
lines.en: My company stayed behind in the last battle.
Even my heartbeat is borrowed.
Seek the living, not me.

lines.zh: 我曾经答应过谁，记不清了。
lines.en: I once promised someone; the name is gone.

lines.zh: 这种事，等我真正死了吧。
lines.en: Ask me again when I am truly dead.

lines.zh: 甲里太挤，装不下两个人。
lines.en: This armor is too cramped for two.
All I could pass on is cold.

lines.zh: 队里没有女骑士，从来没有。
lines.en: There were no women in my company.

lines.zh: 我的婚礼早被埋在城墙下了。
lines.en: My wedding lies buried under the wall.
I bend; my spine clicks three times.
This iron shard, I will keep.
I cannot lift it; my fingers have no strength.
That key should not lie on the ground.
I pick it up; a nail comes loose.

lines.zh: 掉的东西，我都当战利品。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I count as spoils.
There is a hole in my gauntlet.
You take it; I might crush it.
That fragment came off my own armor.
Iron is mine; the rest is for the worms.
Someone has walked across the graves.
A living heartbeat; it is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我听见铁被拔出来的声音。
lines.en: I hear iron being drawn.
That armor belonged to my old company.
A fire burns over by the graves.

lines.zh: 我握紧了剑，手却没有力。
lines.en: I grip my sword, though my hand is weak.
You have moved what should not move.

lines.zh: 我认得那把钥匙的主人。
lines.en: I know the one who owned that key.
These bones suddenly want to stand tall.
Someone is speaking at my grave.
I raise my head; fire fills my sockets.
The target is just behind the stone.
This time, I will not fall again.
I lift my sword clear of the sheath.

lines.zh: 谁碰响了我的甲，我就起身。
lines.en: Whoever rattled my armor, I rise for them.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，铁在地上刮。
lines.en: I close in as iron scrapes the floor.
You have hidden behind a headstone.
I am not fast, but I never turn aside.
My point aims at you; my hand trembles.
Run; I have walked for many years.
That door will not let you out.

lines.zh: 我抬剑的姿势，还是老样子。
lines.en: I raise my blade the way I always did.
The ground is full of my old footprints.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼窝火苗在晃。
lines.en: I watch you; flame sways in my sockets.

lines.zh: 你后退的方向，正是我来的地方。
lines.en: You retreat toward where I came from.

lines.zh: 我把盾的位置记起来了。
lines.en: I remember where my shield used to hang.
One step closer and my blade will reach.

lines.zh: 我的甲在响，那是冲锋前的声音。
lines.en: My armor rattles; that is the sound before a charge.
I do not shout; no one would answer.

lines.zh: 我慢慢横过来，挡住整条路。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block the whole path.

lines.zh: 你绕到侧边，我的剑已经转了。
lines.en: You went around. My sword already turned.
Among the headstones, I know the way better.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，就进了我的旧营地。
lines.en: One more step and you enter my old camp.
The sword comes down trailing rust.

lines.zh: 这一击很重，我差点摔倒。
lines.en: The blow is heavy; I nearly fall over.
You blocked; your hands must be numb.

lines.zh: 我砍偏了，石头崩了一块。
lines.en: I miss; a chunk of stone breaks off.

lines.zh: 骨头使不上力，可剑还在。
lines.en: My bones lack strength, but the sword remains.
I slash across; my plates rattle.
I drilled this cut my whole life.
You fell back; I did not hurry.
I thrust; the point sings.
This one is for the old banner.

lines.zh: 我抬剑太慢，你可别高兴。
lines.en: My raise is slow; do not celebrate yet.

lines.zh: 剑砍在你甲上，声音很脆。
lines.en: My blade meets your armor with a bright crack.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，也不需要喘。
lines.en: I cannot catch breath, nor do I need to.
Block once more and your arm will break.

lines.zh: 我劈下去，力道从骨头里挤出来。
lines.en: I chop down, force squeezed out of old bones.

lines.zh: 你格开了，我却顺势压过去。
lines.en: You parried. I let the weight carry through.
I sit up out of the grave soil.
The armor remains; the man is gone.
Someone is knocking on my headstone.
I wake and first find my sword hilt.
Soil trickles out of my armor's seams.

lines.zh: 我记得自己被埋的那天。
lines.en: I remember the day they buried me.
This armor held up better than I did.
I stand; the grass flattens under me.
No bell rang; I woke on my own.
Keys jingle at my side.
My first breath tastes of grave earth.
I have returned, but my company has not.
My grip has worn marks into the hilt.

lines.zh: 这片墓地，我一个个都认得。
lines.en: I know every grave in this yard.

lines.zh: 火在甲里烧，我闻到自己。
lines.en: Fire burns inside my armor; I smell myself.
I land hard; my knee comes apart.

lines.zh: 水从领口灌进来，我直往下沉。
lines.en: Water pours in at my collar; I go straight down.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast knocks me off my feet.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过甲，卡在肋骨。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my plate and sticks in a rib.
Magic makes my bones hiss and crack.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，只是越来越淡。
lines.en: I need no food; I only fade thinner.

lines.zh: 雷击穿了我，甲片飞出去。
lines.en: Lightning runs through me; plates fly off.
I keep falling and feel no fear.
